title: Probstücke Digital: TEI and MEI encodings of Johann Mattheson's Prob-Stücke (1719/1731)
description:
TEI and MEI encodings of the 24 Prob-Stücke of the Ober-Classe from Johann Mattheson's Exemplarische Organisten-Probe (Hamburg 1719) and Grosse General-Baß-Schule (Hamburg 1731): the figured basses with the variants between both prints and with modern clefs, key signatures and accidentals as editorial alternatives; diplomatic transcriptions of Mattheson's commentary in both prints, linked bar by bar to the score and to the page images of the Bayerische Staatsbibliothek; an English translation; lessons and realisations by Robert Hill, Larry Molinaro, Dijoux and Niels Pfeffer; Mattheson's Register of 1731; indices of persons, literature, musical works and terms; and the word list behind the modernised spelling.

The edition is published at probstuecke-digital.de.
